reason: The primary CIF parses and round-trips as an already primitive P1, Z=1 realization with the stated 6.6624045 x 7.2184603 x 10.7942057 angstrom cell, 509.9105 angstrom^3 volume, and exactly 19 fully occupied sites expanding to Hg11I2BrClO4. Indexing/profile support is strong: all 184 observed peaks with prominence >=2 are covered, 71 isolated reflections refine to about 0.0023 degrees 2theta RMS, and the instantiated CIF gives the trace's 0.992 profile correlation (Rwp-like 0.115); an independent common-profile/background/thermal fit gives correlation 0.997 and Rwp-like 0.066 versus a Pawley-like 0.037 bound, while 90 isolated calculated/refined intensities correlate at 0.996 (R1 about 0.068). Periodic-shell inspection finds no overlaps and bond-valence assignment is exactly Hg2+ Hg1+10 I-2 Br- Cl- O2-4. The Br/Cl swap is inversion-equivalent; the four non-equivalent doubled-cell orderings fit worse under both trace and rechecked common-profile comparisons and predict absent low-angle superlattice peaks (roughly 0.4-1.3% relative intensity against about 0.1 intensity noise). Thus the explicit ordered realization has convergent position and atomic-intensity support, passes validity and chemistry checks, and the only concrete discrete alternatives are covered and rejected, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
